purpose: Make repeated human-machine interaction progressively faster, clearer and more accurate without weakening provenance, scientific, legal, security or effect boundaries.
never_optimize_by: treating user preference as factual evidence
treating cached output as proof authority

evaluation_matrix.comparison_rule: Compare only compatible task classes and equivalent verification requirements.

decision.change_rule: Only an explicit subsequent Owner decision may supersede this requirement; preserve versioned history.

hmi_independence.principle: QIKVRT defines the versioned HMI conformance contract. HMI instances are replaceable interface and transport adapters; QIKVRT state and operation are independent of any particular HMI instance.
invariants: HMI closure, replacement, logout, context truncation, rate limits, storage quotas or missing client timers must not delete or redefine admitted QIKVRT work, grants, evidence or open obligations.
No particular HMI provider, account, conversation, client memory, client Library or client scheduler may be the sole durable authority or sole required carrier of native QIKVRT continuation.
HMI polling cadence constrains that adapter's observations and delivery only; native processing and scheduling use their own declared clock and execution admission.
QIKVRT owns a versioned capability contract; adapters declare transport, modalities, payload bounds, authentication binding, rate limits and delivery semantics before admission.
A replacement adapter reconstructs the admitted task state from QIKVRT through its own verified authorization, without requiring the prior HMI's session, transcript or local files.
Interchangeability does not transfer credentials or widen authority; unavailable capabilities are explicit and cannot be reported as an executed effect.
Human Owner authority and prior scoped grants survive a client change; the new client must verify the applicable identity and grant, without requesting already granted generic permission again.

ingress.acceptance: Acknowledge durable acceptance only after admitted native persistence and independent readback. Otherwise return an explicit rejection or unconfirmed transport state.
ingress.concurrency: Preserve all admitted inputs and causal relations. Serialize conflicting state changes in their native authority scope using existing admission/version checks; keep independent work parallel where allowed.
ingress.capacity: Use explicit bounded backpressure and resumable transfer. Never silently drop, truncate, overwrite or acknowledge an unpersisted request as accepted.

egress.delivery: Persist results and delivery position in QIKVRT. Resume through a replacement HMI from the verified cursor; suppress duplicate logical effects and identify replayed results.
egress.presentation: Render to negotiated HMI capabilities with source-bound text or structured fallback. Preserve meaning, uncertainty, provenance and effect status.

replacement_acceptance: Admit an exact task through HMI A, close A, and prove native continuation and durable state without A.
Bind independently authorized HMI B, reconstruct the same task and grants from QIKVRT, then read the exact persisted result and its evidence.
Prove no lost admitted inputs, duplicate logical effects or silent overwrites under concurrent HMI input, disconnect, retry and reordered delivery.
Prove native scheduling and execution progress while the HMI has no storage and no client schedule.
Prove explicit failure for unsupported capability, unverified principal, stale state, insufficient capacity and ambiguous acknowledgement.
Measure replacement latency and recovery completeness against an explicitly declared acceptance budget; do not invent a latency guarantee.
